author: petr1petr
body:
go to youtube, find Shabbash and check on his guides (some are a little outdated)

join active kingdom and ask them to help you with knowledge.

mage is great, becasue you have very easy access to elements, so you can double your dmg without issues.

world loadout - this should be +view items (lanterns, 2x staff from eye)

you should wear items of your tier, or above your tier (you can see bosses 1tier above yours in world). 

Weapon is the most important item - you can upgrade it when you sleep.

author: UrNewwMann007
body: If possible, upgrade gear or experiment with different gear. Also, check to see if you can upgrade your class further if you haven't already. Wish ya the Best, Good Luck.

author: Icy_Negotiation6868
body:
Mage is already one of the harder ones to play, it requires a fair bit of building in comparison to the other 2. But also at this level you will start to feel weaker as everything doesn't die in 1 or 2 hits.

Try looking up a guide for your class and level, but at this stage you should only be doing dungeons on regular mode and monuments and picking fights carefully.
